summary: Fixed the ledger package to follow docs/conventions.md (half-away rounding, negative formatting, fiscal quarters, rate lookback of 6 months earlier-only, inclusive rate ranges, header-over-dialect layout, reversals booked and valued as their original, per-entry rounded totals, tax rule effective dates, return quarters, HTML total sign, writer jurisdiction). All 755 tests pass; tools/audit.py has one remaining failed check (6.2), because its case expects a 3-month lookback while conventions.md section 6.2 specifies 6 months, so I followed the doc.
